transcript.text: Hi, this is Austin, a virtual health insurance advisor with Darwix Health. This call is recorded for quality and compliance purposes. Is it okay if we continue?
Thank you. How can I help you today? I can answer questions about our health plans, or check which plan might fit you.
Sure, I can help with that. I’ll need a few details to find the best plan for you. Which state do you live in?
Great, you’re in Georgia. We offer the Essential Care plan there. I can give you a quick overview of its benefits and cost. How many people would need coverage, including you?
Thank you. You’re the only one needing coverage. I’ll prepare a quote for the Essential Care plan in Georgia for a single 52‑year‑old. Does anyone who would be covered use tobacco?

I understand you’re not using tobacco. I’ll proceed with the quote for the Essential Care plan. Do you, or anyone who would be covered, have any current medical conditions? You're welcome to skip this one.
I had a kidney transplant two years ago.
I’m sorry to hear about your transplant; a licensed advisor will review that during underwriting. Do you have any health insurance right now?

Thank you for letting me know. I’ll forward your information to a senior health advisor who can review your transplant and provide a detailed quote. What's the best time for a licensed advisor to call you back with a quote?

Thank you. I’ve noted you prefer a call in the mornings. A senior advisor will reach out then to discuss the Essential Care plan and your transplant. Have a great day! And do I have your permission for Darwix Health to contact you about your quote?

Thank you for confirming. I’ve noted your consent for us to contact you about your quote. A senior advisor will call you in the morning to discuss the Essential Care plan and your transplant. Have a great day! Thank you. Because of the condition you mentioned, a senior health advisor will call you to go through your options. Is there anything else I can help with?
